goal: Enable native linux/arm64 rootless Podman development on Apple-Silicon Macs with architecture-aware local images, Spack Clang defaults for development, safe host relays, and unchanged amd64 CI/reference workflows.

steps.task: From the repository root, verify or initialize a rootless native arm64 Podman machine with at least 8 vCPUs, 16 GiB memory, and 100 GiB free VM disk; verify Compose, socat, the VM rootless socket, and host gateway reachability using the specified alpine arm64 probe. Select and record the compliant gateway, bind mode/address, socket path, relay mappings, and firewall evidence when binding 0.0.0.0. Write complete command evidence and selected values to ~/.phlex-devcontainer-tmp/plan-evidence/step-1.md and step-1-values.env. Do not use rootful mode, TCP Podman API, Thunderbolt/USB-LAN without verified routing, or the pinned amd64 image.
steps.context: Evidence must include UTC timestamp, host identity, commands, full outputs, exit statuses, and explicit approval or stop decision. The probe must print phlex-probe-ok. Required variables are PHLEX_HOST_GATEWAY, PHLEX_HOST_RELAY_BIND_ADDRESS, bind mode, PHLEX_PODMAN_SOCKET_SOURCE, and approved mappings.
prohibited_changes: Do not create rootful services or expose Podman over TCP.
Do not use amd64 or emulated probe execution.
Do not record credentials, tokens, or model payloads.
acceptance: Podman is running, native arm64/aarch64, and rootless.
Compose and socat succeed; the VM rootless socket is a real Unix socket.
The selected gateway and compliant bind mode/address pass phlex-probe-ok and are recorded.
Required evidence and step-1-values.env are complete.
verification: Run podman machine inspect, podman info, podman compose version, socat discovery, VM socket checks, and the native arm64 gateway probe.
For mode b, record pfctl and Application Firewall output proving approved-port restriction to the Podman VM source subnet.
Approve only after all outputs and values are recorded; otherwise stop and rerun this step after remediation.

steps.task: Update the four allowed CI image files to select PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET as x86_64_v3 on amd64 and aarch64 on arm64, validate architecture/target matches, select architecture-specific LLVM backends and non-Spack binaries or explicit opt-outs, preserve GCC 15 ABI/cache rules, and add PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER so CI defaults to GCC while phlex-dev defaults to Clang using the Spack GCC 15 toolchain. Leave CMakePresets.json unchanged.
steps.context: Keep existing multi-target definitions and Fermilab mirror behavior. Preserve GCC paths and explain the explicit GCC override. Arm64 must not consume amd64 cache or binaries.
prohibited_changes: Do not modify CMakePresets.json, .github/workflows/*, .actrc, scripts/git-ai-commit, or scripts/test/test_git_ai_commit.py.
Do not stage, commit, push, push images, mutate Podman, or use amd64 artifacts in arm64 images.
acceptance: amd64 selects x86_64_v3 and GCC; arm64 selects aarch64 and provides native LLVM/Clang.
phlex-dev exports CC=clang and CXX=clang++; phlex-ci exports CC=gcc and CXX=g++.
Clang uses Spack GCC 15 headers, libraries, and runtime.
Explicit GCC override remains available and the default CMake preset is unchanged.
verification: Inspect effective Spack configuration and run bounded concretize-only checks for x86_64_v3 and aarch64.
Verify architecture-specific act/tracebox selection or explicit INSTALL_ACT=false/tracebox opt-out.

steps.task: Update the five allowed devcontainer files for Linux and Darwin. Discover and validate the VM-side rootless Podman socket on macOS, require PHLEX_PODMAN_SOCKET_SOURCE, preserve Linux fallback behavior, implement portable socat relays with strict PHLEX_HOST_RELAY_PORTS allowlisting and bind-address/firewall checks, generate JSON/env relay maps outside the repository, expose gateway/map variables, safely rewrite only in-container Kilo JSON/JSONC configuration, and support explicit local base/final image variables while preserving GHCR defaults.
steps.context: Do not claim automatic generic MCP/LSP rewriting; stdio services remain in-container. Preserve credentials and rootless volume layout. Mount ~/.phlex-devcontainer-tmp read-only at /run/phlex-host-relays.
prohibited_changes: Do not modify .github/workflows/*, .actrc, CMakePresets.json, scripts/git-ai-commit, or scripts/test/test_git_ai_commit.py.
Do not expose TCP Podman APIs, require root/systemctl on Darwin, scan ports, relay wildcard traffic, rewrite host Kilo configuration, or rewrite stdio configuration.
acceptance: Linux rootless socket and relay behavior remain functional; Darwin requires the verified VM socket and explicit bind address.
Only approved listening loopback mappings relay, with deterministic maps and safe per-relay cleanup.
Kilo rewrites approved loopback provider URLs in-container; generic clients receive map and gateway variables.
Compose supports explicit local base/final tags and retains the pinned GHCR default.
verification: Run bash -n on ensure-repos.sh and kilo-env.sh and python3 -m json.tool on devcontainer.json.
Run Compose config with local variables and with variables unset; inspect resolved images and socket mounts.
Repeat relay setup with a loopback listener and unlisted port; verify replacement, map contents, negative reachability, and Linux socket usability.

steps.task: Create the allowed architecture-detecting local image builder and Mac guide. Detect native backend architecture, map amd64 to x86_64_v3 and arm64 to aarch64, build ci/dev and the final Compose layer with docker format, tag three local images per architecture, select or disable architecture-specific act/tracebox, isolate optional arm64 Spack cache, and never push or mutate Podman. Document the complete Mac setup, socket/gateway/bind contract, relay allowlist, VS Code selection, compiler behavior, cache/source-build expectations, optional act emulation, and scripts README link.
steps.context: The builder must reject unsupported or non-native arm64 backends and replace only its three local tags. Documentation must state the exact sample mapping 11434=21434,3000=13000 and host-service startup ordering.
prohibited_changes: Do not modify .github/workflows/*, .actrc, CMakePresets.json, scripts/git-ai-commit, or scripts/test/test_git_ai_commit.py.
Do not stage, commit, push images, mutate Podman, reuse amd64 cache for arm64, expose credentials/GPG keys, or generate repository-local relay state.
acceptance: Native arm64 produces localhost/phlex-ci:arm64-local, localhost/phlex-dev:arm64-local, and localhost/phlex-devcontainer:arm64-local.
Native amd64 produces corresponding amd64 tags without CI workflow changes.
Instructions allow terminal-launched VS Code to select local images and verified socket/gateway settings.
Relay state remains under ~/.phlex-devcontainer-tmp.
verification: Run relay parser dry runs for valid, malformed, duplicate, unavailable, and unlisted mappings.
Run architecture-detection and builder dry runs without a full package build, plus repository pre-commit documentation and shell checks.

steps.task: On the operator-provided clean amd64 Linux reference checkout at the same revision, record node/access/tool prerequisites, transfer only the implementation diff without committing, apply it after git apply --check, run all static JSON, Compose, shell, and detected prek/pre-commit checks, build amd64 ci/dev images with PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET=x86_64_v3, run the Linux Compose and relay acceptance, and verify compiler/tool architecture behavior. Record complete evidence in ~/.phlex-devcontainer-tmp/plan-evidence/step-5.md; stop on any mismatch, unavailable node, unexpected fixer change, or workflow/unrelated-file modification.
steps.context: The primary Mac worktree must retain unrelated scripts/git-ai-commit and scripts/test/test_git_ai_commit.py modifications untouched. Fixer changes must be reverted only on transferred implementation paths before approval.
prohibited_changes: Do not modify or transfer scripts/git-ai-commit or scripts/test/test_git_ai_commit.py.
Do not commit, stage, push, mutate the reference Podman machine, push images, copy credentials, or alter GitHub workflows, .actrc, or CMakePresets.json.
acceptance: Static checks, Compose resolution, shell checks, and hooks pass without out-of-scope changes.
amd64 images build and report expected architecture, GCC CI default, Clang developer default, tools, and binaries.
Linux rootless Compose and relay acceptance passes with deterministic maps and Kilo rewriting.
Reference revision and complete outputs are recorded with explicit approval.
verification: Run the exact JSON, Compose, shell, hook, diff comparison, image inspection, and tool checks specified by the source plan.
Run the amd64 builder, Linux Compose service, loopback relay tests, and negative unlisted-port test.
Approve only when all expected values match and evidence is complete; otherwise return findings to the owning implementation step and rerun this step in full.

steps.task: On the Apple-Silicon Mac, source step-1-values.env without re-deriving values, start only approved host services, export the recorded socket/image/relay variables, verify dev.containers.dockerPath=podman, build and inspect the native arm64 local images and VS Code Compose devcontainer, then run the unchanged default CMake configure/build/CTest flow inside it and an explicit PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER=gcc coverage-gcc configure. Verify native Clang, Spack GCC 15 runtime, tools, relay/map/gateway behavior, unlisted-port denial, stdio in-container handling, and optional nested act socket behavior. Record all evidence in ~/.phlex-devcontainer-tmp/plan-evidence/step-6.md.
steps.context: Use the recorded gateway, bind mode/address, socket path, and approved mappings only. If address or reachability is stale, stop and repeat step 1. Optional AI credentials/Headroom checks may be reported unavailable but image, tool, build, and relay correctness are mandatory.
prohibited_changes: Do not modify repository source, .actrc, or GitHub workflows.
Do not select amd64/emulation for native acceptance, use rootful Podman or TCP API, change CMakePresets.json, forward unlisted ports, or record credentials/model payloads.
acceptance: All three local images and the final devcontainer run as native arm64.
Default development configure/build/CTest succeeds with Spack Clang and unchanged CMakePresets.json.
Clang uses Spack GCC 15 rather than system GCC 13; explicit coverage-gcc uses GCC.
Approved host services relay through recorded mappings while unlisted and stdio paths remain appropriately blocked/in-container.
Podman remains rootless and complete evidence shows no generated source or credential files.
verification: Capture machine/socket/info, image architecture, compiler identification, tool paths, CMake, CTest, relay listener/map, endpoint, negative-port, and git status outputs.
Verify the arm64 tags, local image selection, VS Code setting, gateway/bind/firewall mode, and optional VM-socket act path.
Approve only after successful configure, build, tests, and all mandatory acceptance evidence; otherwise stop with the failing spec/cause/recovery and resume at the owning step.
